source_caption:
Tulsa King (2022) follows Dwight “The General” Manfredi, a New York mobster who is released from prison after spending 25 years behind bars. Expecting to return to the life he once knew, Dwight quickly discovers that his loyalty to the mob has not been rewarded the way he expected.
Instead of welcoming him back, his crime family sends him to Tulsa, Oklahoma, a place completely unfamiliar to him. With no established connections and no real support, Dwight begins building his own criminal operation from the ground up.
Using his experience, confidence, and old-school approach, Dwight starts recruiting people around Tulsa and turning unlikely relationships into valuable alliances. But building an empire in unfamiliar territory comes with plenty of enemies, rival criminals, and complications.
The series explores themes of loyalty, power, betrayal, ambition, family, and starting over. Dwight may be an old-school gangster, but he quickly realizes that the modern world operates very differently from the one he left behind.
What makes Tulsa King compelling is the contrast between Dwight's traditional mafia mentality and the unfamiliar world he is forced to navigate. His attempts to establish himself in Tulsa lead to unexpected partnerships, conflicts, and moments of dark humor.
More than just a crime drama, Tulsa King is about a man trying to rebuild his life and reputation after decades away, while creating an empire in a city where nobody knows his name.
💬 After 25 years in prison, Dwight wasn't going to let a new city stop him from building his empire.

source_details.synopsis: Tulsa King is an American comedy and crime drama television series created by Taylor Sheridan for the streaming platform Paramount+. The series stars Sylvester Stallone as Dwight "The General" Manfredi, an American Mafia caporegime who has been recently released from prison in New York and is sent to Tulsa, Oklahoma, where he begins to set up a criminal organization. It is Stallone's first leading role in a scripted television series. The series also stars Andrea Savage, Martin Starr, Jay Will, Max Casella, Domenick Lombardozzi, Vincent Piazza, A. C.
